The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored layered tunic, divided lower layers, offset closures, reinforced cuffs, and contrasting plum boot laces remain accurate, but the worn colored-thread spool visible in the corrected summon is missing, breaking the required source accessory and personal-anchor continuity.

Visual measurement places the complete hair-and-head unit at approximately 27.5% of standing figure height, about 3.6 heads tall, below the required 32-36% window and outside the mandated 2.75-3.1-head range.
Exactly one complete subject appears; the full hair, head, both hands, layered hems, both boots, laces, and grounding shadow remain within generous safe margins with no crop or duplicate anatomy.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance, compact silhouette, separated hands and boots, mantle shape, and restrained palette read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.
The image remains ordinary mortal cloth and travel wear with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, or watermark.
